# SEO-502: Keep entry identifiers stable across rebuilds

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Each entry carries an identifier that stays the same for the life of the item, independent of its title, its address, and its position in the feed.

## Rationale

Readers deduplicate on the identifier, so an identifier that changes on rebuild republishes every item as new and shows subscribers the same content again.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_feeds"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Derive the identifier from a persistent record key rather than from the current address or heading, and never regenerate it when the item is edited.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Capture entry identifiers from two consecutive builds and report any identifier that changed while its item persisted.
- Evidence: `FEED`, `BUILD_OUTPUT`, `FILE`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_NEWS`, `AI_ASSISTANT_RETRIEVAL`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
